item.title: El Paso airport shutdown a ‘case study in miscommunication’
item.description: The Federal Aviation Administration’s announcement to shut down El Paso International Airport for 10 days due to an alleged cartel drone incursion from Mexico smacks of overkill, several local officials said.

item.title: One dead, two injured in Eagle Mountain crash
item.description: One person is dead after a car crash on Eagle Mountain Boulevard this afternoon, and two others were transported to the hospital.

item.title: Audit of Utah DHHS reveals records for millions of patients, including children, exposed
item.description: A new report from the Utah State Auditor revealed issues with privacy practices within the Department of Health and Human Services, leading to records for millions of patients being exposed.

item.title: Utah Legislature votes to get involved in federal redistricting lawsuit via amicus brief
item.description: After several elected Republican officials in Utah filed a federal lawsuit to try to block Utah's new Congressional map for the 2026 election, the Utah legislature has decided to get involved, filing an amicus brief in the case.

item.title: Assistant Mapleton HS coach charged for providing alcohol to minors in exchange for sexual relations
item.description: A now-fired assistant coach from Maple Mountain High School has been charged with sexually abusing two 17-year-olds in exchange for alcohol.

item.title: Summit County warns of dangerous mountain roads: Don't get stranded
item.description: Summit County Sheriff's Office is warning the public not to be fooled by the low amounts of snow this year, as many mountain roads are still dangerous, even if they're not gated off.

item.title: Lawsuit filed against Park City Mountain resort over two ski lifts
item.description: A Utah non-profit company is suing Park City Mountain Ski Resort, arguing that two ski lifts violate a land agreement and asking Park City to immediately stop operating those ski lifts.

item.title: Horizon Elementary students donate cereal for 'domino effect of kindness'
item.description: Students at Horizon Elementary School have been bringing in boxes of cereal for donations all month to learn that one act of kindness can affect many other people.

item.title: Wasatch County Republican party releases statement after chair arrested for allegedly waterboarding 16-year-old
item.description: The Wasatch County Republican Party released a statement after their Chair was arrested for allegedly waterboarding his 16-year-old family member.

item.title: West Jordan mother says 15-year-old daughter escaped attempted kidnapping during Lyft ride
item.description: A West Jordan mother told ABC4 that her 15-year-old daughter was almost kidnapped in broad daylight, and she has a message to share.
